description: This Java class 'ThemeFactory' manages theme models and visual themes within the OFBiz framework. It handles loading theme XML files, caching theme data, and resolving visual themes based on user session, preferences, or default settings.

classes.name: ThemeFactory
classes.description: A utility class for managing theme models and visual themes, including loading, caching, and resolving themes based on user context.

methods.name: readThemeDocument
methods.description: Creates a ModelTheme instance from an XML Document representing a theme.

methods.name: pullModelThemesFromXmlToCache
methods.description: Reloads all visual themes from theme XML files into cache.

methods.name: checkForWidgetFolder
methods.description: Checks a directory for theme XML files within widget subfolders.

methods.name: getThemeXmlFiles
methods.description: Scans theme and plugin directories for theme XML files.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFromId
methods.description: Retrieves a VisualTheme object from cache by ID, reloading cache if necessary.

methods.name: getModelThemeFromLocation
methods.description: Resolves and loads a ModelTheme from a given resource location, caching the result.

methods.name: getAvailableThemes
methods.description: Returns a list of VisualThemes linked to a specific theme set, combining cache and database entries.

methods.name: resolveVisualTheme
methods.description: Determines the current visual theme based on user session, preferences, or default properties.
